# Learnagement

Outil d'intégration des données de l'enseignement : le pont entre étudiants, enseignants et administratifs de l'USMB.

Size **Medium**: production app, real users, several contributors (`ion repo set size=…`).
Backend FastAPI in `backend/`, frontend Next.js 16 + React 19 in `frontend/`.

## Commands
- `ion repo dev`: dev servers in background, nothing asked; never `--foreground` from Claude (API http://localhost:8000/api/, docs `/api/docs`; front http://localhost:3000). Then `ion repo dev logs [service]|status|stop`. Worker or background task: `name: command` line in its folder's `Procfile.dev`.
- `ion repo check`: the stack's checks (ruff, mypy, pytest, ESLint, type checks), then `charter`, on what the branch changed, tests only with `--tests`; `--all` the whole repo, as on a `release/` branch. Run before saying a change is done.
- Python dependency: `uv add <package>` in its directory (`--dev` for a tool).
- JavaScript dependency: `pnpm add <package>` in `frontend/` (`-D` for a tool); never npm.
- `ion repo update`: ion-repo improvements and compatible upgrades, on a branch, checks included. `ion repo set key=value`: change a project setting.

## Language
- Talk with the user in French; docs, commits, comments, tickets, user-read text too.
- Identifiers always English; `docs/backlog/` keywords (`Type`, `Priority`, `Status`, `todo`) too.

## State
- README describes the project now: a command, setting, route or run change updates it in the same branch.
- `docs/backlog/`, only work list (`/repo:backlog`): `tickets/` (a file per open `learnagement#T-NN`, format in `how-to.md`; list: `ion repo backlog`), `releases/` (a file per planned release), `README.md` (index, next free ID), `done.md`, `rejected.md`, `urgent.md` (human-only).
- `.claude/` committed: `settings.json`, `skills/`, `rules/`, `hooks/`, `plans/`; ignored: `settings.local.json`, `worktrees/`, `memory/`, `sessions/`.
- `charter.toml`: checked rules, budgets. `waivers.toml`: deviations. `.copier-answers.yml`: settings, via `ion repo set` only.

## Git
- **[NO-COMMIT-ON-MAIN]** Never commit on `main` or `develop`: dedicated branch, preferably a worktree (`/repo:worktree`, `.claude/worktrees/`). Inside it, Claude Code's isolation refuses what it cannot read (`cd`, `git -C`, a variable in a path, a heredoc, a loop, `$(…)`): edit with Edit/Write, send git commands plain and one by one; never dodge it through a script in `/tmp`. Merge into `develop` with `/repo:merge`, no PR or approval needed (PR optional for an opinion). Enforced by pre-commit `no-commit-to-branch`, ion-repo's branch guard, GitHub rulesets (`develop` not deletable or force-pushable; `main` only via `/repo:release`).
- **[BRANCHES]** `feat/`, `fix/`, `refactor/`, `test/`, `chore/`, `docs/`; lowercase, no spaces (`feat/station-map`).
- **[COMMITS]** Atomic: max 10 files, title max 50 chars, typed with optional scope (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `style:`, `docs:`, `perf:`, `test:`, `build:`, `ci:`, `chore:`, `revert:`; `fix(map): …`); migration commit never mixes schema and business logic. Claude trailer per machine (`ion repo set ai_trailers=disclose|never`, enforced by branch guard); never `Claude-Session:` or `--author`.
- **[FETCH-FIRST]** Another session may be merging while you build. Before a decision that rests on the project's setup, and at least before the last commits: `git fetch`, read `git log HEAD..origin/<integration>`, merge what it gained into the branch early rather than late.
- **[MERGE]** `git merge --no-ff`, never squash or rebase onto the integration branch; then delete branch (local, remote) and worktree (`/repo:merge`).

## Work
- **[REPRODUCE-FIRST]** Reproduce a bug (failing test or command) before fixing. Check any diagnosis, yours or another session's, on a copy first.
- **[DIRECT-LINKS]** Online step asked of a human: give its direct link, never a menu path.
- **[STOP-BY-PID]** Stop a process by its port or PID (`ion repo dev stop`), never `pkill -f`: the pattern also matches the shell running it.
- **[CHAINED-COMMANDS]** Chain steps that depend on each other with `&&`, `set -o pipefail` before a pipe: a failure hidden by `|` or `;` lets the commit or merge go.
- **[RELEASE-ASKED]** A change that needs production: say a release is needed; start one only on the user's order.
- **[VERIFY-BEFORE-CLAIM]** A figure, a price, a capability that can be checked is checked before it is stated; said from memory, it is marked as such.
- **[CANONICAL-NAME]** Before archiving, deleting or transferring a repo: `gh repo view` its real name; an old name redirects to a repo still in use.
- **[CLAUDE-CODE-REACH]** Before saying Claude Code cannot do something (display, behavior), check settings, themes, hooks and plugin mods (`modules` in a plugin's `hooks/hooks.json`, `on('ui.render', …)` redraws a message): a mod often can.
